_note: Scouted only palmaholding.com (Palma Holding / Palma Development's own site). No agency or portal site was opened - no PropertyFinder, Bayut, dubizzle or any aggregator - and no form was filled, no brochure requested, no stock photo used. Every image below was opened at full size in the browser and looked at before being described; filenames and alt text were treated as unreliable and only confirmed against what the picture actually shows. ATTRIBUTION: Palma's site carries several separate Serenia developments - Serenia Living and The Royal Sky Mansion (Palm Jumeirah, /our-project/serenia-living-buy-apartments-palm-jumeirah/), Serenia Residences (Palm Jumeirah, /our-project/serenia-residences-palm-jumeirah-houses-dubai/) and West Residence at Jumeirah Islands. None of those were used. The three images below all come from the East-specific editorial pages - /east-residences-serenia-district/ (the East Residences masterplan article, 11 Mar 2026, which states the cluster comprises East Residence 2, East Residence 3 and East Residence 4 at Jumeirah Islands), /east-residence-3-serenia-district/ and /east-residence-2-serenia-district/. The renders match that description: mid-rise beige-and-glass residential towers set in landscaped ground with the Jumeirah Islands lakes and the JLT/Marina skyline behind - not the beachfront Palm Jumeirah setting of Serenia Living. EXCLUDED: https://palmaholding.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Banner-Image.png from the Serenia District project page - LOOKED: it is a genuine EXTERIOR aerial render, but the subject is the WHOLE Serenia District masterplan (a full skyline of a dozen-plus towers over the Jumeirah Islands lakes), so it cannot be attributed to the East Residences specifically and is not usable as this building's lead. Also excluded: the rest of the Serenia District project page, which is amenity and icon artwork (clubhouse, pools, BBQ areas, playgrounds, yoga deck) at district level, plus an unrelated La Mer Private Home award image that appears in the sidebar of every post. RESULT: three genuine wide exteriors with the BUILDING as the subject, all architectural renders rather than photographs (the towers are under construction). The first is the strongest lead candidate - it shows the East cluster as a group from outside. No amenity aerial, no pool deck, no shot taken from inside or from a balcony is included.

images.note: LOOKED: EXTERIOR, elevated/low-aerial three-quarter view, architectural RENDER (not a photograph). The BUILDING IS THE SUBJECT - three beige-ribbed residential towers of the East Residences cluster stand across the frame with balconied facades reading top to bottom, a slim glass tower behind them and the Dubai skyline hazy in the distance. Terraced landscaped podium gardens and low townhouse-scale blocks run along the bottom third, but they are foreground context, not the subject. This is the best lead candidate: a genuine wide shot from outside showing the buildings themselves. 2041x2042.

Landscaped grounds and a small pool terrace sit at the tower's base in the lower quarter of the frame but occupy little of the picture and are clearly subordinate to the tower.
